verdict.rationale: Codegen documents that its agents can create pull requests with code changes, and an agent-permissions setting controls whether the agent may create PRs in your repositories. The docs do not explicitly describe a configuration that makes the agent open a PR automatically when its task completes; PR creation is framed as happening 'in response to user requests.' missing for 10: explicit documentation of an auto-open-PR-on-task-completion setting, details of PR configuration options (draft vs ready, target branch), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes

citations.quote: Agents can create new pull requests with code changes
Control whether the codegen agent is able to create pull requests in your repositories in response to user requests.
